events.line: Ilir, you absolute coward—Stroud just put up 35 fucking points on your bench while you were out there playing it safe with whatever geriatric backup you started instead. That's what happens when you don't have the balls to ride with your guy.
Jetmir, you absolute fucking moron—you benched Bryce Young and he put up 20.3 points on your bench while you were out here playing it safe with some waiver-wire castoff, didn't you?

Faton, you absolute coward—benched Shough and he puts up 19.7 points on your bench like it's nothing, way over his projection. That's the kind of "trust your gut" decision that's gonna haunt you when you're explaining why you left 20 points on the fucking table in December.

Arben somehow stumbled ass-backwards into starting Jordan Love and doubled his projection like he knew what the fuck he was doing—congrats on the accidental genius, you're still gonna choke in the playoffs anyway.
You benched a defense that put up 19 fucking points? What the hell were you thinking, Jetmir—did you accidentally hit the wrong button or do you just hate winning?

Nori really said "nah, I don't need 18.5 points on my bench this week" -- Tank Dell just went off for nearly 5x his projection and you couldn't trust him enough to plug him in, absolute shit decision.

Adam sat Drake Maye on the bench and watched him put up 18 fucking points anyway—congrats on leaving points on your bench like an asshole, but at least your backup QB managed to not completely blow it for you.
Rinor really said "nah, I'm good" and benched Justice Hill right before he put up 16.7 points—that's what we call leaving money on the goddamn table, you absolute walnut.

Veton really said "Josh Jacobs is gonna save my season" and then watched him get absolutely buried in the Vegas backfield for 0.5 fucking points—that's what you get for trusting a guy who can't even stay healthy enough to vulture a goal-line carry.
Nori, Jared Goff just shit the bed harder than a newborn and you watched it happen live—14 points underwater on projection and you had him slinging it out there like he was gonna save your season.
